question: Who makes Avocadox avocado oil
markdown:
Avocado oil is not made by a single company or brand named "Avocado." Instead, it is produced by
many different food and oil brands worldwide
that extract the oil from the pulp of fresh avocados, typically using a cold-press or centrifuge method.
Healthline
Major Brands That Make Avocado Oil
Chosen Foods:
A leading global brand known for 100% pure avocado oil.
La Tourangelle:
An artisan oil maker offering handcrafted avocado oils, detailed on
⁠La Tourangelle Delicate Avocado Oil
Olivado:
A pioneer brand recognized for mass production and commercializing extra virgin avocado oil.
Avomexicano:
A popular label providing cold-pressed extra virgin avocado oil sourced from Mexican Hass avocados.
Local & Regional Brands:
Various domestic and imported labels package and sell pure or blended avocado oil for cooking and skin care.
California Avocados
How Production Works
Harvesting:
Producers gather ripe, A-grade avocados (frequently Hass varieties).
Pureeing:
The skin and pits are removed, and the flesh is ground into a smooth paste (similar to guacamole).
Extraction:
The paste goes through a centrifuge machine to separate the natural fruit oil and water without high heat.
